caseName: Ferguson Reorganized School District R-2 v. United States
caseNameFull: Ferguson Reorganized School District R-2 v. United States Berkeley School District v. United States and Kinloch School District v. United States

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. Certiorari denied. The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Powell would grant certiorari in No. 75-214 limited to question whether a federal court has authority to fix and impose the school tax rate upon the residents of the consolidated school district without allowing the rate to be determined in accordance with Missouri law. Reported below: 515 F. 2d 1365.
